Antigua and Barbuda
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade
Regular biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade
Service/Official biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade
Diplomatic biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade
The citizens of Antigua and Barbuda are exempted from visa requirement for entry, exit , transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days within a period of six months starting from the date of first entry.
